notes: Prices are dollars per million tokens. A cache write is billed as an ordinary cache-miss input token.

DeepSeek: "Peak hours are 01:00 - 04:00 and 06:00 - 10:00 UTC, Monday through Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays. All other hours are off-peak, including weekends and Chinese public holidays in full."
Each call is priced by the time it was sent. Make-up working days that fall on a weekend count as off-peak, since the rule names Monday to Friday.
Add each year's holidays when the State Council publishes them (usually in November); `make doctor` warns when the current year is missing, and missing days are priced as peak.
